4.  The  following  new  section  is  hereby  inserted
immediately after section 10 of the principal enactment and
shall have effect as section 10A of that enactment :—

“Offences.
10A.  Every person who contravenes or fails
to comply with the provisions of this Act or any
regulation made thereunder shall on conviction
after summary trial by a Magistrate be liable to
imprisonment of either description for a term
not  exceeding  one  year  or  to  a  fine  not
exceeding one hundred thousand rupees, or to
both such fine and  imprisonment.”.
